methodologyNotes: Built-in stitches as integer count of unique stitch patterns (not stitch applications). Max sewing speed in stitches per minute (spm). Max stitch width and length in mm. Weight in lbs (machine only, no shipping box). Presser feet as integer count of included feet. Buttonhole styles as integer count. Bobbin type as string (top-load or front-load). Boolean specs (automaticNeedleThreader, lcdScreen, freeArm) as true/false. Null for any spec the manufacturer does not publish on its US spec sheet or that could not be confirmed from primary sources.
